subject: design/citation-resolution
statement: the check walks the same governed corpus `check-links` walks (the `docs/` tree plus the operating manual and templates), and finds citation tokens in prose and table cells. It reuses `check-links`'s line scanner: a token inside a fenced block or an inline code span is an example, not a citation, and is skipped (DINV-3) — the two-stage recognition the cross-document ledger arm already established (a resolvable slug shown as `` `prd:x/FR-1` `` never fires).
